method: Each LitPop cell (its centre point) inside the region (the target units' bounding box widened by region_margin_deg) is assigned to the boundary polygon it intersects; a cell on a shared edge goes to the smallest unit ID. A unit's value is the sum of its cells' values; its lat/lon is the value-weighted mean of its cells' lat/lon (WGS 84). Boundaries are reprojected from NAD83 to WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).
